steps.text: Type {login_email} in the email box, then mouse-click 'Get Started Free'. A JavaScript click does not work here; use a real mouse click.
On /onboarding/welcome, tick the Terms checkbox. Mouse-click the reCAPTCHA checkbox (a plain click passes). Then click 'Sign Up It's Free'.
On /onboarding/verify, type {phone} in the phone_number field and click 'Verify with SMS/Text'. This creates the account for {business_name} and is the send.
